question: The value of (279 ÷ 31) + (363 ÷ 33) − (512 ÷ 16) is:
solution:
**Given:**

(279 ÷ 31) + (363 ÷ 33) − (512 ÷ 16)

Concept used:

The BODMAS rule should be followed as per the given table:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c660a1c8668e6d4748af4828543c6ca808c1c87976e99d3a5150b34f7ba7ceb.png] 

**Calculation:**

__(279 ÷ 31)__ + __(363 ÷ 33)__ − __(512 ÷ 16)__

= __**9 + 11**__ - 32

= 20 - 32

= - 12

**Hence, The Required value is - 12.**
